title: A rigid ball pressed 0.04 mm into a steel block: frictionless contact in the kernel (demonstration)

provenance.purpose: contact with a rigid obstacle, G24 step 3: a quarter of the block (symmetry planes x = 0 and y = 0), its mesh graded toward the contact point by formulas that keep a slope at every face (x^3 alone would fold the quadratic elements there, and the kernel refuses such a mesh), the ball given as a sphere; the contact pressure on the surface in the frame. A demonstration: Hertz's point contact is the reference for a ball on a half-space, and this block is finite and held at its base (on 2026-10-09 its force came out 4.2 % over Hertz's, its peak pressure 2.4 % over); kerneltest K19 checks the method against Hertz's line contact

controls.label: how deep the ball presses, m
